notes.title: My First Three Visual Novels Are Now On Steam!
notes.content:
The first three visual novels I ever published are now available on Steam in one collection!

[u]They Cannot Hear Me[/u]
It's the middle on winter and a lonely man goes for a walk late at night. He spends the time thinking about how sad his life has become and how things will likely never change for the better for him. Will anything interesting happen on his walk or is he doomed to spend the rest of his life alone? As he walks around town he'll be reminded of events from his past. The man in the story doesn't have a name because it's not really important, so you can assume it to be whatever you want. Since this is a short kinetic visual novel there really isn't much else to say. There are no choices, it's just a really short story.

[u]Trapped[/u]
When you wake up in a prison cell, you have no memory of who you are or how you even got there. If you don't want to rot to death, it's up to you to find a way out and explore the island you've been trapped on with a girl you'll meet outside named Mila. Like you, she has no idea how she got to the island or what's going on. If you want to get out of there, both of you are going to have to work to together to escape! If you're not careful, your choices could lead to your death or you'll just have to die of old age alone. Whichever comes first.

[u]The Weird One[/u]
Camille has made up her mind and plans to confess her feelings to a friend of hers. However, what she doesn't know is that this guy is much weirder than she thinks. Whatever choices she makes will have a huge effect on whatever universe she's in. Some decisions may allow her to continue to have a normal life but others will throw her in all kinds of weird situations. Will Camille be able to tell Dave how he she feels about him or will he drag him into whatever weird things are going on with him?

notes.title: My Latest Visual Novel Is Now Available On Steam!
notes.content: The latest visual novel that I've worked on, Winter Dream, has finally made it to Steam! When it comes to its format, it is similar to School For The Friendless. However, the big difference here is that when you complete the routes for the three girls in this game, the story keeps on going. In this visual novel, you follow a boy named Caron Duff who is moving in with his uncle during his Winter vacation. When he gets there, everything feels more familiar than it should. Not only that, but the three girls he ends up meeting all of some kind of connection to him. But that doesn't mean everything is going to be alright. All three of them are dealing with some kind of pain caused by past incidents. As he gets to know them, he'll learn more about them, and what their connection to him actually is. If you're interested, you can check the game out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805810/Winter_Dream/]here[/url].

notes.title: Update To Achievements
notes.content: The reason achievements stopped working was because I forgot to install a plugin when I updated the program I made this visual novel with. If you've already gotten to the points in game that would give you achievements, you're going to need to erase your saves. There are two places you must delete them from: the game's directory and your AppData folder, which you can get to by typing "%appdata%" in your search bar. After that, achievements SHOULD be working again.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
After several days of doing nothing but breathing oxygen, I realized School For The Friendless could use an update so I forced myself to get to work and make some changes to the code. Now, it's slightly better than before! I've only made a few changes to already existing content, but that doesn't mean there won't be more stuff related to School For The Friendless in the future. Below is a full list of what's new in this version.

- Reduced required point values for each route by one to make it a bit easier to avoid the friendless ending.
- Fixed a bug where the backlog wouldn't work after the word "[REDACTED]" showed up. 
- Made some minor tweaks to the dialogue.
- Removed Herobrine.
